title: Doom Metal
tagline: Slow, crushing riffs that make every note feel monumental.
summary: Doom metal stretches heavy riffs into slow, weighty forms. Long sustain, low tunings, and spacious arrangements create a sense of scale that can feel mournful, ominous, or meditative. While Black Sabbath supplied an early blueprint, later scenes developed distinct approaches, from epic vocals to dense, distorted minimalism.

pillars.name: Black Sabbath
pillars.why: Black Sabbath's slow, ominous riffs supplied a central early reference point for doom metal.

pillars.name: Pentagram
pillars.why: Pentagram helped carry a raw, riff-centered American strain of doom through changing lineups and eras.

pillars.name: Candlemass
pillars.why: Candlemass brought a grand, dramatic scale to doom, pairing slow heaviness with soaring vocals.
